name: HAPI ICU Admission
remarks: Augmentation module: marks ICU admission for sepsis/septic shock patients.
Uses a local synthetic ConditionOnset (system: http://hapi-dse.local/CodeSystem, code: icu-admit)
to avoid code collision with the congestive_heart_failure module which already uses
SNOMED 305351004 (Admit to ITU) as a Procedure.
Sets is_icu_admitted=True in HAPI DSE extraction by detecting this condition code.

codes.display: Patient admitted to intensive care unit
